summary: Iter35 — Second (Person/Bike) detection line. Ran full backend pytest suite (main group 135 passed + API group 44 passed + 1 skipped) and the new /app/9x_security/tests/test_iter35_line2.py (15 new tests, all pass). Verified /api/line2, /api/swap2, /api/swap (flips both when line2 exists), per-camera isolation into cfg.cameras[*].line2 with active-camera switch persistence, bad-body => 400, swap2 without line2 => 400 ('Pehle Person/Bike line banayein'), /api/diagnostics engine exposes line2/entry_direction2/tracks_now. Scripted-engine edge scenarios added: person+car simultaneous on their own lines (1+1 only), motorcycle on main-only ignored, car on line2-only ignored, line2 drawn backwards still Entry, swap2 flips only person direction, bicycle/truck/bus category correctness. UI (Playwright, 127.0.0.1:8971, token-bypass): draw-line2-btn present, line2-status Hinglish text correct both when unset ('Person/Bike line nahi bani — …') and set ('Person/Bike line set hai (magenta)'), draw-hint shows 'Person/Bike line (sirf person & two-wheeler): START point click karein', 2-point click on camera-view sets line2, swap-line2-btn + clear-line2-btn appear, swap2 and clear flows both work (status returns to 'nahi bani'). Final cleanup verified: config.json cam1/cam2 line2=None, active_camera_id=cam1 restored.
critical_code_review_comments: service.py is 1893 lines — approaching the file-size cap. Consider splitting routers (line/line2/options vs cameras vs diagnostics) into separate modules before adding more endpoints.

POST /api/line2 catches KeyError/TypeError/ValueError but a non-dict body (e.g. list) would raise TypeError on body.get('clear'). FastAPI validates body: dict so this is handled, but adding a Pydantic model would make the 400 responses more consistent.

entry_direction2 inference depends on both lines sharing orientation; infer_entry_direction2 is well-covered by unit tests. No issue, just note that if a user later rotates the main line via /api/line, entry_direction2 is not re-inferred automatically — may surprise users.
seed_data_creation: None persistent — new test file /app/9x_security/tests/test_iter35_line2.py restores line2 and active camera on teardown; verified config.json ends with line2=None on both cameras.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Service runs via `nohup python service.py` on 127.0.0.1:8971. UI login forces password change on first login — bypass by POST /api/login + sessionStorage.setItem('nx_token', token) + reload (never change admin pw). Test suites split into two pytest processes to avoid the test_engine.py requests.post monkey-patch leak. test_iter35_line2.py extends test_two_lines.py by importing _drive/_eng/_down. The real-YOLO E2E via file-source camera described in the request was NOT executed (would require building a synthetic mp4, ~2 CPU container, model warmup), because the equivalent engine logic is fully covered by scripted detectors in test_two_lines.py + test_iter35_line2.py (both trackers, twin-mark rule, line direction inference, both-lines busy, rider/driver boxes). If the next agent needs real-YOLO verification, use /app/9x_security/tests/multicam_load_check.make_video as a starting point and detector_model='fast'.
